svg.title: One transition specification run deterministically and as exact stochastic draws
svg.desc: Panel a: infectious hosts over 120 time units in a 400-host SIRS model: a shaded 5th to 95th percentile band across 256 direct-SSA paths, their median, and the deterministic solution of the same specification. Panel b: mean cumulative infection, recovery and waning events per path from the retained event counts.
